<function name="GetSelectedLine" parent="DListView" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Gets the currently selected <page>DListView_Line</page> index.

If <page>DListView:SetMultiSelect</page> is set to true, only the first line of all selected lines will be returned. Use <page>DListView:GetSelected</page> instead to get all of the selected lines.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The index of the currently selected line.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="Panel">The currently selected <page>DListView_Line</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
